description: Get known public subsidies (subventions publiques) received by an association, resolved to its RNA from French open data. Returns yearly grants with funder (attribuant), purpose (objet) and amount. IMPORTANT: NON-exhaustive — only covers local authorities (collectivités) that publish SCDL open data, NOT the State. Absence of data does NOT mean the association received nothing. The RNA only lists loi-1901 associations.

association_id.description: RNA ID of the association (format: W followed by 9 chars, e.g., "W751000001")

name: get_association_subventions
